rule: public_origin is set only at release (owner decision B8, 3 October 2026: not yet). Form: https://<host>, optionally followed by a path of lowercase segments of a-z, 0-9 and '-', with no trailing slash, query or fragment; the decided address is https://causewaygrp.com/financial-inclusion-evidence (B1: Arabic at that root, English under /en/). With an origin the build writes absolute canonical, hreflang, og:url, og:image and structured-data addresses, the sitemap, and a robots.txt that allows crawling and names the sitemap (under a path, crawlers read only the domain's own robots.txt: docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md). The base path is the origin's path: dist/ (the review build every gate reads) keeps root-relative links, and the published site, scripts/build.py --out, carries every link, asset, stylesheet and runtime address under it. Until then robots.txt disallows crawling, no sitemap is written and the build is byte for byte unchanged. See FINAL_OPEN_ITEMS_REGISTER.md. Implementation: scripts/discovery.py, scripts/base_path.py; gate: scripts/tests/test_base_path.py.
pre_release_rule: While pre_release is true every page, the root entry and the 404 included, carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow"> (owner decision B3, 3 October 2026): under a path, crawlers ignore the robots.txt the build writes, so the pages themselves say it. It is set to false at release, after the owner's acceptance (docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md, step 13); the 404 then keeps its own noindex. Checked by scripts/validate.py (RC-NOINDEX). Implementation: scripts/discovery.py.
licence_rule: The reuse licence is decided and the rights question is closed: CC BY 4.0 for the content CauseWay owns in this resource (adopted 3 October 2026, audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-02.md section E and the owner note of about 11:15, 3.6; closed 10 October 2026, audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_2026-10-10.md, OWN-04-R). This flag decides nothing about that licence. licence_text_confirmed records only that CauseWay's counsel has confirmed the CC BY 4.0 text that /rights/ and /terms/ print, in both languages (adversarial verification of the base-path work, 3 October 2026). It stays false until a dated line in audit/OWNER_DECISIONS_*.md records the confirmation (docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md, step 7a). The deploy workflow refuses to publish while it is false, because the first deploy makes /rights/ public at the host's own address (the App Platform app, owner decision of 3 October 2026 on DigitalOcean hosting) even before the corporate route exists. Checked by scripts/validate.py (RC-B14). This is the reuse licence (Arabic رخصة), not regulatory licensing (Arabic ترخيص): CauseWay is not a licensed financial institution and claims no such status. The repository's software code is outside this licence and no code licence is decided.
downloads_rule: public_downloads publishes the data exports (scripts/exports.py: CSV and JSON with a bilingual codebook and provenance on every row) under /downloads/. The licence they would carry is decided (CC BY 4.0, licence_rule above); public_downloads stays false until CauseWay's counsel has confirmed the CC BY 4.0 text (licence_text_confirmed, docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md step 7a) and the owner then switches it on (step 2). scripts/build.py copies build/exports/ into dist/downloads/ only when it is true, and scripts/tests/test_exports.py and the validator fail if a download is in dist/ while it is false. See docs/RELEASE_RUNBOOK.md.
